rationale: The agent authenticated the user (found user by name/zip and retrieved user details) and accessed relevant orders. However, it executed order-changing actions—returning three items from order #W7553978 and exchanging an item from order #W3239882—without obtaining explicit customer confirmation beforehand. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action prior to performing it. While the actions (returns for two skateboards and a smartwatch, and an exchange for the e-reader) align with the user’s intended outcomes, proceeding without confirmation violates the policy. Additionally, the final response provided no explicit confirmation or details of the transactions. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
